item.title: Flo’s Kitchen extends business hours
item.description: Troy staple Flo’s Kitchen is extending its hours through spring and offering a new Big Sexy Burger alongside comedy nights and private event packages.

item.title: Master Gardner's meeting set for Feb. 18.
item.description: Learn how native plants can enhance your garden and support the environment at Pike County Master Gardeners’ Feb. 18 Lunch and Learn with horticulturist Joshua Cook.

item.title: Work progressing on ECMH crisis diversion center
item.description: Construction is moving forward on East Central Mental Health's 4,000-square-foot crisis diversion center in Troy, which will offer 24/7 short-term stabilization and outpatient services.

item.title: Sheriff Russell Thomas lends support to Lady Trojans
item.description: Pike County Sheriff Russell Thomas visited undefeated, No. 3-ranked Charles Henderson's Lady Trojans, backing deputy-coach Thad Frazier as the 26-0 Area champs enter 5A playoffs.

item.title: TAC discusses upcoming events
item.description: Troy Arts Council unveils its 2026 February Art & Culture Calendar, highlighting local exhibits, blackout poetry and a comedy show, with weekly updates posted on JCA’s Facebook.

item.title: Charles Henderson grad Quintarries Upshaw receives Golden Apple Award
item.description: Charles Henderson alum Quintarries Upshaw, a civics and U.S. history teacher at Workman Middle School in Pensacola, earns a Golden Apple Award for his classroom leadership and literacy advocacy.

item.title: Troy, Brundidge awarded SEEDS Grants
item.description: Alabama’s SEEDS program has awarded grants to Troy and Brundidge—Wiregrass’s only recipients this round—to prepare industrial sites and boost competitiveness for major projects.

item.title: Alabama Attorney General warns of ‘romance scams’
item.description: Alabama AG Steve Marshall warns residents about rising online romance scams, urging extreme caution on dating sites and advising victims to report cases quickly.

item.title: CHHS Soccer opens 2026 season
item.description: CHHS soccer opens 2026: boys rout Montgomery Catholic 7-2 behind Daniel Frigge’s four goals, while short-handed Lady Trojans fall 5-2 despite two scores from Reece Garrett.

item.title: Artists reception Thursday night for Dan Fraley
item.description: Johnson Center for the Arts hosts reception tonight for local artist Dan Fraley, whose “ART: My Life’s Legacy” showcases a life spanning the Marines, Disney, music and Troy art events.
